component.name: Direct RDP & VNC
component.summary: Connect to your own computers over RDP and VNC

description.p: A plain remote desktop client. Type the computer's address, sign in, and you're in. There's no account, no relay server and nothing to install on the other computer.

ul.li: RDP for Windows PCs, GNOME Remote Desktop and xrdp
VNC for Macs (sign in with the Mac account) and other VNC servers
The remote desktop resizes to fit the window
Passwords are kept in the system keyring
Wake on LAN, Ctrl+Alt+Del and full screen

description.p: Video on a Mac plays smoothly: the new Automatic picture, now the default, shows full quality while the screen is calm and switches to Apple's Adaptive picture while much of it moves, then repaints sharply once it settles.

Macs keep up with movement: the Mac now sends every change as soon as it happens, as Apple's own viewer does. Macs show in full quality by default, and the new Picture Quality menu switches to Adaptive when the connection is slow.
Macs now send their screen in Apple's own Adaptive picture format, which uses a fraction of the data of plain VNC and keeps up much better with movement.
Copy and paste now works in both directions with Macs, using the Mac's own Screen Sharing clipboard.
Copy and paste text between this computer and VNC computers, including Macs.
